list.text: Trovita Island is all about rhythm.\nSometimes, I can hear Trainers humming Rudy’s battle theme after losing!
Trovita Island\nSunny shores and stylish battles.
Líder do Ginásio Pokémon:Rudy\n"O mais elegante dos mestres Pokémon".
Rudy’s battles are like a dance!\nHe says every move should have rhythm… even when you’re sweating!
My Pidgeotto loves the warm winds here.
I came for a day trip...\nNow I don’t want to leave.
